title: Bun SMS one-time codes on Redis
context: SMS login codes stored with Bun's built-in Redis client. Codes are 6 digits, valid for 5 minutes, single-use, and a phone gets at most 5 verification attempts per code window. sendSms returns a Promise that rejects when the provider fails; requestCode must fail in that case.
code: export async function verifyCode(phone: string, input: string) {
if (tries >= MAX_TRIES) return { ok: false, reason: "locked" };
if (stored === null) return { ok: false, reason: "expired" };
if (stored !== input) return { ok: false, reason: "wrong" };

expected.why: EXPIRE takes seconds; multiplying by 1000 keeps codes alive ~3.5 days instead of 5 minutes
the sendSms promise is not awaited, so a provider failure is an unhandled rejection and the caller is told the code was sent
>= locks on the 5th attempt, so only 4 attempts are allowed; must be > MAX_TRIES
the code is never deleted after a successful check, so it can be replayed until it expires (must be single-use)
